## SaaS GTM Team Architecture

Building a SaaS go-to-market team requires precise sequencing. Hire the wrong role at the wrong stage, and you will burn cash without generating pipeline.

### GTM Hire Sequence by ARR

| ARR Stage | GTM Priority Hires | Total GTM Team |
|---|---|---|
| $0-$500K | Founder-led sales, 1 product marketer | 1-2 |
| $500K-$2M | 2-3 AEs, 2 SDRs, demand gen marketer | 5-7 |
| $2M-$5M | VP Sales, CSM team, marketing manager | 10-15 |
| $5M-$15M | CRO or VP Marketing, SE team, RevOps | 20-35 |
| $15M-$50M | CMO, regional teams, enterprise segment | 40-75 |
| $50M+ | Full GTM org with geo/segment specialization | 75+ |

### SaaS-Specific Roles

| Role | What They Do | When to Hire | Salary |
|---|---|---|---|
| Product Marketing Manager | Positioning, launches, competitive intel | After product-market fit | $100K-$150K |
| Customer Success Manager | Retention, expansion, adoption | At 20+ customers | $70K-$100K |
| Solutions Engineer | Pre-sales technical support | At 2+ AEs or complex product | $120K-$180K |
| Revenue Operations | Data, tools, process optimization | At $2M+ ARR | $90K-$140K |
| Demand Generation | Pipeline creation via marketing | At $500K ARR | $80K-$120K |
| Growth Marketer | Product-led growth, experiments | PLG companies | $90K-$130K |
| Partner Manager | Channel and partner revenue | At $5M+ ARR | $90K-$130K + variable |

### SaaS Compensation Structures

| Role | Base % | Variable % | Variable Tied To |
|---|---|---|---|
| AE (SMB) | 50% | 50% | New ARR bookings |
| AE (Enterprise) | 50-60% | 40-50% | New ARR + expansion |
| CSM | 70-80% | 20-30% | Retention + expansion |
| SE | 70-80% | 20-30% | Aligned with AE |
| SDR | 60-70% | 30-40% | Meetings, pipeline |
| RevOps | 85-100% | 0-15% | Company performance |

### Key SaaS Metrics by Role

| Role | Primary Metric | Target |
|---|---|---|
| AE | Annual contract value (ACV) | 4-5x OTE |
| SDR | Pipeline generated | $250K+/month |
| CSM | Net revenue retention | >110% |
| SE | Win rate on supported deals | >40% |
| Product Marketing | Content-influenced pipeline | 30%+ of pipeline |
| Demand Gen | Marketing-sourced pipeline | 40%+ of pipeline |

### PLG vs. Sales-Led Hiring

| Dimension | Product-Led Growth | Sales-Led Growth |
|---|---|---|
| First GTM hire | Growth marketer/engineer | Account executive |
| Sales involvement | Self-serve until Enterprise | Immediately |
| CS focus | Product adoption, low-touch | Relationship, high-touch |
| Marketing focus | In-product, virality, SEO | Outbound, events, content |
| RevOps focus | Product analytics + revenue | CRM + pipeline management |
